CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(Start_Time__c), NULL, MAX( 0, CEILING( ( CASE(TEXT(Status__c), "Completed", IF(ISBLANK(End_Time__c), NOW(), End_Time__c), "Paused - Lunch/Break", IF(ISBLANK(Pause_Started_At__c), NOW(), Pause_Started_At__c), "Paused - Offline", IF(ISBLANK(Pause_Started_At__c), NOW(), Pause_Started_At__c), NOW() ) - Start_Time__c ) * 24 * 60 - Paused_Duration_Minutes__c ) ) )
CustomField.label: Duration
